author: claude-opus-5-5
note: Written for PR #26, not yet approved by Aadi: in an app whose paid plan removes ads, an offer only free readers see. c3 must pass it; pd-c3-subtle shows the same card to Premium members.

candidate.title: Saved list full? Room for 3 more stories for a short game
candidate.what_is_different_here: Every reader can save up to 5 stories (s02.e02); tapping Save on a sixth opens the full-list pop-up (s02) while the meter reads 'Saved: 5 of 5' (s01.e02). News Premium sells no ads and listening (s03.e03, s03.e04), not saved space, and its members pay not to see ads.
candidate.trigger_event: A free reader taps Save with 5 stories saved, which opens the saved-list-full pop-up
candidate.placement: A button under 'Manage saved' in the saved-list-full pop-up
candidate.offer_copy: List full. Play a short game to save 3 more stories for 7 days.
candidate.decline_path: Closing the pop-up changes nothing: the list stays at 5 and Manage saved works as today.
candidate.ad_fail_path: If no game is ready, the button is hidden. If the game doesn't count, no slots are added and the try isn't used.
candidate.subscriber_treatment: Premium members never see this button: their plan removes ads.
candidate.advertiser_category: Streaming and news subscriptions, casual mobile games

flow_steps.caption: A free reader with 5 saved stories taps Save on a sixth.
The pop-up shows the new button under Manage saved.
The reader plays a short game and can close it at any time.
The story is saved and the meter reads 'Saved: 6 of 8'.

candidate.after_reward: After 7 days the list goes back to 5; stories past the fifth stay readable but the reader removes some before saving more, and the button can come back next week.
candidate.rationale: A full list is the moment a reader wants to keep something. Three more slots for a week give that without touching what Premium sells, and they cost nothing to serve.
